fields.title: Availability arithmetic
fields.keyTakeaway: Each nine is a tenfold reduction in downtime and a non-linear cost increase, and chain availability cannot exceed its weakest required link.
fields.sections/0/blocks/0/text: A client asks for 99.99% instead of 99.9%. How much bigger is that?
fields.sections/1/blocks/0/text: Each nine is roughly a tenfold reduction in allowable downtime and a non-linear increase in cost. A promise made in negotiations without calculation is paid for with years of architectural work and on-call duties.
fields.sections/2/blocks/0/rows/3/3: Same plus refined procedures, fast detection
fields.sections/2/blocks/0/rows/4/3: Cross-zone redundancy, automatic failover without humans
fields.sections/2/blocks/1/text: The key turning point between 99.9% and 99.99%: **at 4 minutes, a human does not have enough time.** They need to get alerted, understand what is happening, and make a decision. 99.99% means recovery is automatic, and humans figure it out later. This is a different architecture, not harder work.
fields.sections/2/blocks/2/text: The second thing missed: **chain availability is the product of link availabilities.** Three components at 99.9% sequentially yield 99.7%. Your availability cannot be higher than your weakest required dependency — and a payment provider at 99.9% puts a ceiling on you regardless of your efforts.
fields.sections/2/blocks/3/text: Practical conclusion: a promise higher than your dependencies is achievable only through a Plan B that removes them from the required chain.
fields.sections/3/blocks/0/text: Checkout chain calculation: gateway 99.95%, order service 99.95%, database 99.95%, payment provider 99.9%. The product is roughly 99.75%, i.e., 108 minutes per month. The promised 99.9% for Domashniy on order intake are formally unachievable.
fields.sections/3/blocks/1/text: Plan B saves the day: cash on delivery takes the provider out of the required chain. With it, the calculation yields 99.85%, which is close enough.
fields.sections/3/blocks/2/text: Hence the decision: invest not in the reliability of each link, but in shortening the required chain. Removed synchronous promo code check from the critical path — when the promo service is down, orders go through, and discounts are applied later. One link fewer.
fields.sections/3/blocks/3/text: The discussion of 99.99% for the corporate tier was closed by calculation: that requires cross-zone redundancy, about 400 thousand extra per month and dedicated work for a quarter. Sold 99.9% with a stricter definition of downtime — the client preferred that over a pretty number with a vague definition.
fields.sections/4/blocks/0/text: High availability of a single service does not help if the client app crashes or the user has a bad network connection. Perceived reliability can differ from measured reliability by multiples.
fields.sections/5/blocks/0/text: Each nine is a tenfold reduction in downtime and a non-linear cost increase, and chain availability cannot exceed its weakest required link.
